figures.caption: Decoherence number $\mathcal{N}(T)$ as a function of superposition time $T$ for power-law FLRW spacetimes with $p = 1.5, 2, 3$ and for de Sitter spacetime ($H = 1$). For $p > 1$ (future causal horizon present), $\mathcal{N}$ grows without bound — logarithmically for power-law FLRW and linearly for de Sitter. For $p = 1$ (no causal horizon), $\mathcal{N}$ saturates to a finite constant. All curves are for the scalar field; the electromagnetic field gives $\mathcal{N}_{\rm EM} = 2 \mathcal{N}_{\rm scalar}$.
figures.label: fig:decoherence
